# ctables/argv

> Command-line arguments: a `[str]`, built once from `main`'s `argv`.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/argv.pkg) · translates [std/argv](../std/argv.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
__pk_argv()
@alloc
```

Includes: [ctables/alloc](alloc.md)

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
static W __pk_argv_cache;
static W __pk_argv(void) {
if (__pk_argv_cache) return __pk_argv_cache;
W h = __pk_alloc(24);
W d = __pk_alloc(8 * (W)__pk_argc);
((W *)h)[0] = d;
((W *)h)[1] = __pk_argc;
((W *)h)[2] = __pk_argc;
for (int i = 0; i < __pk_argc; i++) {
W n = (W)strlen(__pk_argv0[i]);
W s = __pk_alloc(n + 9);
*(W *)s = n;
memcpy((char *)s + 8, __pk_argv0[i], n);
((W *)d)[i] = s;
}
return __pk_argv_cache = h;
}
```
